messages:
marie-sales: Heads up — WillowBank wants a short POC run to validate SSO + SCIM provisioning before we go to pricing. They specifically called out domain proofing, SCIM delta support, and RBAC delegation.
luca-solutions: Good call. Do we have a minimal checklist we can run them through? I can do the SAML metadata exchange and a quick SCIM smoke test.
marie-sales: Yes — they want answers by EOD Wed. Can we confirm what we need from them and what we can demo without Dedicated? They asked about private key handling for SAML assertions and KMS integration.
sam-se: For the demo we can use SP-initiated SSO with AD FS / Okta. We'll need their IdP metadata (XML) and a test user set. For KMS: our Hosted flow uses service-side key storage; Private customers can bring a KMS. If they need HSM-backed signing, that's Private-only.
elaine-sales: @sam-se can you note any pricing implications? WillowBank asked whether SCIM provisioning events count toward token/requests billing or are part of the Dedicated commit.
sam-se: Quick note: SCIM provisioning is metered on API requests for Hosted. For Dedicated we can include an optional provisioning through the Reserved pool (negotiate). I'll put a short pricing blurb in this thread after we confirm scale (users/sec and sync cadence).
anna-security: Security check: they require signed SAML assertions with SHA-256 and SP metadata to be uploaded into their IdP. Also need a domain verification TXT record for: willowbank-app.verification.redwood-inference.example
anna-security: Domain proofing steps we normally provide:

1) Provide DNS TXT value for verification (they publish it)
2) IdP metadata exchange (XML)
3) Confirm SP ACS and EntityID
4) SCIM service account details + token rotation cadence

We need an answer on whether they require delegated admin via SCIM groups (we support group push but delegated admin has extra design work).
marie-sales: They do require delegated admin scoping (helpdesk team should only manage support roles). Is that doable in the POC or does that require Product changes?
luca-solutions: We can demo group-based RBAC mapping with a simple attribute mapping for the POC (willowbank-helpdesk -> role:helpdesk). Full delegated-admin UI (self-service) is a product ask; not in a 2-week POC scope.
marie-sales: Noted. I'll tell them managed delegation is in roadmap and we can provide a manual workaround for the POC.
vikram-se: SCIM notes for the test plan:
- Support for PATCH (RFC 7644 delta) required by WillowBank
- Rate limits: we have a 10 req/sec default on Hosted; can provide burst for POC or recommend delta batching
- Example header: `Authorization: Bearer X-SCIM-TOKEN`

Small SCIM payload example for group sync:
```
POST /scim/v2/Groups
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "displayName": "willowbank-helpdesk",
  "members": [{"value":"user-123"}]
}
```
sam-se: If they insist on real-time provisioning and delta events, recommend using a short sync window (15s) for the POC and we'll measure token/sec. That will determine whether they need Dedicated.
marie-sales: Pricing ask: they want a committed quote if we can support 5k users with nightly delta sync and SSO. Can you draft a baseline estimate (hosted vs dedicated) please? Include cost for increased SCIM rate and 24/7 SRE support add-on.
sam-se: Baseline estimate: Hosted — usage for SCIM + API auth at current rates (approx $X/month for 5k active users with nightly delta), potential extra for higher SCIM throughput. Dedicated — starting at a monthly commitment with predictable per-user cost; I'll DM finance for exact numbers but rough guidance: Dedicated commitment reasonable if sustained ~500k monthly tokens. I will attach a quick calc after lunch.
elaine-sales: I'll prep the security questionnaire answers (SOC2/KMS/keys, encryption at rest/in transit, audit logs). @anna-security any known blockers for WillowBank's compliance checklist? They marked "bring your own key" as must-have.
anna-security: BYOK/HSM for signing is Private-only. For Hosted we can offer key rotation and strict logs but not customer-managed HSM. That is likely the main compliance roadblock; putting it on the contract/roadmap is an option. Also we need their DPA + data residency confirmation.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: demo sandbox cluster for sales POCs is free for 7 days. Provisioning ETA: 48 hours after we get IdP metadata + one admin user.
marie-sales: Action items:
- willowbank to send IdP metadata XML and DNS owner confirmation (marie-sales to collect)
- sam-se to draft pricing estimates (hosted vs dedicated + SCIM burst)
- luca-solutions to run SAML exchange and try group mapping demo
- anna-security to draft questionnaire answers and note BYOK constraint
- infra-bot to provision demo sandbox after inputs

Any other blockers? :thinking_face?
vikram-se: One more: confirm they can accept SCIM bulk imports (CSV) for initial seed; that avoids heavy delta traffic at start.
marie-sales: Great — I'll get back with their metadata today and ask about CSV seed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
